nudge: The merlin, 'esmerilhão', is 'um pequeno falcão', and the bank keys it for 'codornizes', quail. Rabbits and ducks are the distractors.

language.note: rações = prepared animal feed; not 'rations' of food.
consumiriam = would consume: what the bird would eat if it were wild.

nudge: A bird of prey is fed food 'idêntica à que consumiriam no estado selvagem', what it would eat in the wild. Feed made essentially of 'rações' is not that diet, and a ban on 'penas ou pêlos' is the other distractor.
The goshawk, a bird of prey 'de baixo-voo', is used for 'tanto de pena como de pelo', both feathered and furred game. Each other option keeps only one half.

The goshawk is 'a ave clássica da caça em baixo-voo', low flight with short-winged hawks flown straight from the fist, as question 501 also says. Alto-voo, high flight, belongs to the long-winged falcons, so neither the goshawk nor the sparrowhawk is its classic bird.

language.note: mais … do que = more … than: each option sets the terçó against the female, and the comparison runs from the male's side.

nudge: The terçó is the male bird of prey, smaller than the female, so neither 'mais corpulento' nor 'do mesmo tamanho' fits. The bank keys it 'mais ágil do que a fêmea', more agile.

language.note: pelo here = by the (por + o), not pelo 'fur'; each option names what the condition is judged by.

nudge: A bird of prey's physical condition is read 'pelo peso', by its weight. Size and feathers are the distractors.

language.note: processo = method, a legal way of hunting; not 'process' or a lawsuit.

nudge: Cetraria is falconry: game taken by 'aves de presa', with only hunting dogs and a stick, 'com ou sem pau', to help (question 51 names it the same way). Bows and crossbows and traps are other means, not this method.

language.pt: Indiferentemente de noite ou de dia
language.en: Either by night or by day
language.note: indiferentemente = either one, without preference; not 'indifferently' in the sense of carelessly.

nudge: Manning, 'amansamento', taming a new bird to people, is done 'de noite', by night. 'Indiferentemente' would make day just as good, and the stem's 'preferencialmente' says one time is preferred.
